title: GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee)
description: Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Shift Operator) We are looking for Graduate Engineer Trainees (Shift Operators) . Freshers are welcome to apply. This role provides an opportunity to develop hands-on technical expertise in water treatment plant operations, maintenance, documentation, and operator competency. Key Responsibilities Ensure adherence to industrial safety practices during all plant operations and maintenance activities. Operate and monitor pre-treatment, water generation, storage, and distribution systems as per prescribed SOPs. Ensure optimal and safe operation of all plant equipment. Monitor utility and feed-water parameters and ensure compliance with specified operating limits. Prepare and maintain operational records, including log sheets, chemical consumption records, preventive maintenance (PM) records, and other required documentation. Verify sensor calibration using appropriate test kits and maintain relevant records. Coordinate with the QC team for water sampling and analysis. Perform basic/non-critical maintenance activities, such as attending to minor leakages, using available tools. Record operational issues, observations, and corrective actions in accordance with QA documentation procedures. Participate in classroom and hands-on technical training conducted by CN and customers to develop and maintain competency in plant operations. Assist in conducting periodic hands-on training for operators and support competency assessment and certification. Follow assigned shift schedules and support contingency arrangements at the site. Perform assigned site administrative activities, including HR compliance, documentation, invoicing, payment follow-up, and other related responsibilities. Follow all applicable SOPs, safety procedures, quality requirements, and customer/site guidelines. Eligibility Diploma in Engineering – Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Instrumentation / relevant discipline. Freshers are welcome to apply. Candidates with experience in DM / RO / Purified Water Systems / Utility Operations & Maintenance will also be considered. Willingness to work in shift operations and site environments. Good learning attitude, discipline, and willingness to develop technical and operational skills. How to Apply Interested candidates can directly share their CV: Email: isha.lad@cnwater.in Call / WhatsApp: 84509 64162 Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹19,000.00 per month Benefits: Food provided Provident Fund Work Location: In person

title: Graduate Apprenticeship Trainee - Helpdesk
description: Overview: Bruker is enabling scientists to make breakthrough discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high-performance scientific instruments and high-value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular and microscopic levels. In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy and nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics and proteomics research and clinical microbiology. Today, worldwide more than 11,000 employees are working on this permanent challenge at over 90 locations on all continents. Bruker continues to build upon its extensive range of products and solutions, its broad base of installed systems and a strong reputation among its customers. Being one of the world's leading analytical instrumentation companies, Bruker is strongly committed to further fully meeting its customers’ needs as well as to continue to develop state-of-the-art technologies and innovative solutions for today's analytical questions. Bruker India invites fresh graduates and aspiring professionals to be a part of our prestigious Graduate Apprenticeship Program, launched under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). This is a gateway to begin your professional journey with one of the world’s leading scientific instrumentation companies, committed to innovation, learning, and development. This structured 12-month program offers immersive learning experiences across various business functions, giving you real-time exposure to operations, technologies, and corporate dynamics. Responsibilities: In-depth working on Salesforce Service Max for case logging and management Vonage calls handling, following escalation procedures, and documentation Using remote diagnostic tools for initial issue identification Understanding log file analysis and system performance checks Shadowing experienced engineers during remote support sessions Learning how to guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps. Assisting customers with preventive maintenance tasks Engaging in advanced troubleshooting techniques Handling customer interactions and conflict resolution Contributing to the internal knowledge base and documentation. Gain hands-on experience with demo systems and software testing. Collaborating with field service engineers and other teams. Professional Growth: Learn from experienced mentors and industry leaders while working on live projects and tools. Skill Development: Sharpen your technical and analytical skills through structured training and on-the-job learning. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gain end-to-end business insights while working closely with diverse teams. Innovation Exposure: Be part of a company that empowers scientific discovery with cutting-edge solutions. Qualifications: Recent graduates (Bachelor’s) in Engineering in Electronics & communication, Instrumentation, Bachelor’s or Masters in Physics/Electronics/Instrumentation.
company_description:
We are a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-performance scientific instruments and analytical and diagnostic solutions that enable our customers to explore life and materials at microscopic, molecular and cellular levels. Many of our products are used to detect, measure and visualize structural characteristics of chemical, biological and industrial material samples.

In close cooperation with our customers, Bruker is enabling innovation, improved productivity and customer success in life science molecular research, in applied and pharma applications, in microscopy & Nano analysis, and in industrial applications, as well as in cell biology, preclinical imaging, clinical phenomics, proteomics research and clinical microbiology.

title: Trainee Electrical Transmission Line Engineer - T&D
description: Description We Saved a Spot for You We welcome talented and ambitious graduates from all backgrounds who will help us shape the future of engineering and our company. At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll have the opportunity to establish a thriving career within the transmission and distribution industry. The industry is evolving rapidly, driven by data centres, renewables, and the need for resilience. The grid has never been more critical. From planning and design to construction and operations, we blend technical insight with strategic foresight. A committed team player able to work on own initiative Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, client service orientation Self-starter with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written to communicate effectively with internal team members and external clients. Additional Responsibilities: Open to candidates from Tier-2 cities. Willingness to learn transmission line engineering/design tools and processes. Flexibility to support DEF program work and other project requirements as needed. Ability to work with teams supporting the FLA office and accommodate project-related schedules. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Civil engineering, with 1-2 years of experience. Skills Required: Good English proficiency and strong communication skills. Strong technical foundation, analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office, engineering analysis tools, and Google Earth. Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools and processes. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and work with different clients globally. Flexibility to take on varied roles and responsibilities. Why Join Us? At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll be empowered to build not just projects, but your career. Our expansive service offerings mean stability, job security and incredible potential for growth. We take on the world’s toughest challenges and use our skills, experience, and courage to solve them. A Caring Place Where Careers Grow Our entrepreneurial spirit sits at the foundation of who we are as an organization and constantly drives us forward toward innovation, strategic growth, and service excellence. We believe in putting forth our ﬁnest effort, including on behalf of our employee-owners. Our beneﬁts package includes comprehensive beneﬁts that demonstrate our commitment to the well-being of the individuals who contribute to our clients’ success every day. Work From Home (as per policy) The ability to work from home is available as per company policy, providing flexibility and work-life balance where applicable. Hybrid models may apply depending on role and department. Flextime and Day Flextime Program Flextime allows employees to choose their own start and end times within a set range. Employees have an option to choose staggered working hours — with an option to work for six hours at the office and two hours remotely — depending on their schedule. Bus Service We provide a dedicated company bus service for a comfortable, timely, and cost-effective commute for all employees. Multiple pickup points Saves on travel costs Provides on-time arrival Stress-free daily travel On-Site Fitness Facility Each on-site ﬁtness facility provides employees with convenient access to exercise equipment and classes that support physical well-being and a healthy lifestyle. The events not only reflect our values but also build lasting memories, boost morale, and strengthen workplace bonds. And many more... At Burns & McDonnell, our engineers, construction professionals, architects, planners, technologists and scientists do more than plan, design and construct. With a mission unchanged since 1898 — make our clients successful — our more than 13,500 professionals partner with you on the toughest challenges, constantly working to make the world an amazing place. 

Each professional brings an ownership mentality to projects at our 100% employee-owned firm, which has safety performance among the top 5% of AEC firms. As dedicated owners, we work through challenges until they’re resolved, meeting or exceeding our clients’ goals.

We apply this commitment to our communities, too. We live and work in the same cities you call home, so we share a passion to keep them strong and healthy. From fundraising events and community cleanups to educational outreach and mentorship — especially when it comes to sharing our passion for STEM — our professionals work to make our communities thrive.

title: Software Development Trainee
description: Job Description Have you set the course for the future? We’ll give you the green light! Because at Frauscher, we always have our eyes firmly fixed on progress. Let’s embark on this journey together! Our agility and enthusiasm for new things are reflected in our innovative technologies and services – and, of course, also in our corporate culture. Join Frauscher now and start your career journey with the technology leader! At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. Our industry leading field elements, software, connectivity and data access solutions, combined with smart life cycle services, ensure system critical components are operational and provide the information rail operators need to maximise the safety, efficiency and capacity of their networks. We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being "Your partner for confidence." Role Overview We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Software Development Trainee to join our software development team. The role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, working with technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Angular, and Rust. The candidate will work alongside experienced developers to develop, test, and maintain software applications while building practical engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and maintaining software applications. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code following established coding standards. Participate in software debugging, troubleshooting, and testing activities. Work with SQL databases and perform database operations and queries. Understand technical requirements and contribute to their implementation. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior developers. Collaborate with team members to complete assigned development tasks. Follow software development processes and continuously improve technical skills. Qualifications & Experience BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Systems. Candidates who graduated in 2025 and above are eligible to apply. Fresh graduates with 0–1 year of experience. Basic knowledge of at least one programming technology: Java, Kotlin, Angular, or Rust. Knowledge of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming concepts. Internship experience in software development is preferred. Training certification in any of the above technologies is an added advantage. Familiarity with Git and software development practices is preferred. Basic knowledge of working with AI-assisted software development tools is preferred. Strong motivation, willingness to learn, and passion for software development. Good analytical, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Strong team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and contribute positively to team goals. In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Are you bursting with curiosity and creativity? Do you have brilliant ideas and want to set the course for the future, today? If so, embark on your Frauscher journey with us! Additional Information What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First? At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other. Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. Culture powers us and the possibilities. We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. Handle learner queries, objections and negotiations confidently. Build a strong sales pipeline through consistent follow-ups. Maintain accurate interaction and follow-up records in CRM. Achieve daily activity goals and weekly/monthly enrolment and revenue targets. Deliver a professional, positive learner experience throughout the sales process. Typical Daily Activity 100+ 120+ min 6 days Call attempts / day Learner talk time / day Working days / week Activity matters, but quality of counselling, learner experience and conversion performance are equally important. Who Should Apply? Graduate or Postgraduate in any discipline. Freshers and candidates with 02 years of experience are welcome. Inside Sales, B2C Sales, EdTech, Education Sales, Tele Sales, Admissions or Counselling experience is an advantage. Strong verbal communication, interpersonal skills, listening and questioning ability. Confident handling objections and negotiating with prospects.
